sloka: तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धे नैकशस्त्रमयं महत् ।विमुच्य राघवरथं समान्ताद्वानरे बले ।। ६.१०९.१९ ।।
transliteration: tadvarṣamabhavadyuddhe naikaśastramayaṁ mahat ।vimucya rāghavarathaṁ samāntādvānare bale ।। 6.109.19 ।।

translations.english: In that war, noisy, alarming, fearful loud noise of weapons of different kinds, in huge numbers, descended.
